llm_response.reason: The site pretends to be the official shop for the well-known Calida brand, but uses an unrelated domain (springhorace.shop) rather than Calida's actual official domains (e.g., calida.com). This is a core scam indicator of brand spoofing. Additionally, there is no visible mandatory contact or company information (e.g., Impressum) which is required by law in German-speaking e-commerce, another strong scam indicator. Prominent urgency discounts and promises of safe shopping further match common scam tactics. Together, this evidence confirms scam characteristics typical of fake online shopping sites.
